missing_fields.evidence_needed: Executed successor appointment, scope of service, necessary customer and site consents
One stipulated trigger and transition start date; no actual distress event is asserted
Dated power, staff, hosting, network, management, tax, repair and priority debt payments, including settlement cutoffs
Dated customer receipts, payee, account, restrictions, setoff, refund and diversion rights
Account statements by legal entity and site, unrestricted/restricted classification and release authority at the start date

missing_fields.status: Conditional mechanism; issuance and terms unknown
missing_fields.evidence_needed: Executed L/C, undrawn amount, issuer, expiry, draw notice/form, honoring time, reimbursement party and successor use permission
Signed commitment, permitted use, conditions/waivers, draw timing, priority, fees and repayment proceeds
Executed MSA Direct Agreement, Management Agreement, collateral-access/SNDA and account-control/step-in provisions
Separate pledged repayment proceeds or an explicit model that includes repayment in the event stream; avoid double counting

reopen_gate: A coherent same-operator, same-site, same-trigger, same-date package establishes implementable operations and timed cash accessibility. A larger issuer balance sheet or another generic covenant is insufficient.
